findings.description: The vector-of-variants build overwrites the stored variant with the new command exactly like the other two: id then pwd attacks each fetch once (3,5) and the following victims see the new output after a refetch. Key shape stays host+raw target; only the command payload inside the entry changes.
findings.title: e1a28e35: attacker-chosen command replaces the variant vector entry

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
